name: stream-transport-framed-stream-core
title: StreamTransport over arbitrary byte streams + shared framed_stream core
description: Add StreamTransport and PersistentConnection::from_stream over any AsyncRead+AsyncWrite stream; extract the transport-neutral FramedStream core shared with TcpTransport; refuse STLS explicitly; cover handshake, cancel-safety, concurrency, write and multi-session behavior with deterministic tests.
creator: magicdian
